test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM for the underlined word.

My teacher is very __diligent__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Idle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"diligent"** means someone who is careful and conscientious in their work or duties. (परिश्रमी)

 
 
• **Example: **My teacher is very diligent in preparing lessons for us.
 
 
 
• **"Idle"** refers to someone who is avoiding work or being lazy. (आलसी)
 
 
• **Example: **He spent his idle hours watching TV and playing video games.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'diligent' **is **'idle'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Idle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Skilful **(कुशल): Having or showing skill.

 
 
• **Example:** She is very skilful in playing the piano.
 
 
 
• **Hardworking **(मेहनती): Tending to work with energy and commitment.
 
 
• **Example: **The team is very hardworking and dedicated.
 
 
 
• **Kind** (दयालु): Having a friendly, generous, and considerate nature.
 
 
• **Example:** He is always kind to everyone he meets.
